title: Jake Barber's psionic assets locking onto craft

tellings.quote: thing which is uh I know Jake Barber is obviously a source for Ross

plain: A man named Jake Barber is said to work with "psionic assets", people said to use mental or psychic ability, who lock onto unknown craft. Michels mentions it in passing, noting that Barber "is obviously a source" for the journalist Ross Coulthart. If true, it would mean the mind is being used as a tool to find these craft.
